topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I keep going over the times we played, the secrets we shared under the old oak tree. I wonder if I misremembered, if those moments were just dreams I mistook for reality. Maybe I wasn’t as important as I thought. I’ve been replaying our last conversation, searching for what I might have done wrong. I find myself avoiding him now, not wanting to bring up the past and see that confusion, that blank look in his eyes. It feels like a part of me is fading, and I can’t help but think it’s somehow my fault.
